Clara application screenshots — 9 November 2026

Captured from the actual Phoenix application in /home/drasko/ideas/clara, served at http://127.0.0.1:4000. Chromium, 1440 x 1000 CSS pixels, light theme, device scale factor 1.

plays.png: /fieldnotes-website-demo/plays — live content-play catalog.
linkedin.png: the same route with the real LinkedIn play dialog open and a fictional Fieldnotes brief entered. The play was not submitted.
brand.png: /fieldnotes-website-demo/brand — saved fictional brand voice, audience, and writing guidelines.

The application used a separate local PostgreSQL database named clara_website_screenshots, with background queues disabled, and a dedicated local demo identity. Existing Clara development data was not migrated. The app source was not edited. Screenshots were taken directly through Playwright with no DOM substitutions or image edits.

The temporary capture scripts and browser session are not included in the website. These image files contain only demo workspace information.
